verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing and rolling back deployed workflows is a fair question for an ML hosting and deployment platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any versioning, change review or rollback capability. The cited items cover running, fine-tuning, deploying via Cog, autoscaling, metrics/logs and pricing, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
